items.docs: Retrieves the list of available sensors on the device. Each sensor type uses a GetDefault() static method to check availability. Supported types include Accelerometer, Gyrometer, Compass, Inclinometer, LightSensor, Barometer, Altimeter, Magnetometer, OrientationSensor, Pedometer, ProximitySensor, ActivitySensor, HumanPresenceSensor, and HingeAngleSensor.
Retrieves the current accelerometer reading using Accelerometer.GetCurrentReading. Returns G-force values along the x, y, and z axes. The sensor coordinate system is fixed to the device.
Retrieves the current gyrometer reading using Gyrometer.GetCurrentReading. Returns angular velocity in degrees per second along the x, y, and z axes.
Retrieves the current compass reading using Compass.GetCurrentReading. Returns heading in degrees relative to magnetic north and optionally true north (if the device has a GPS receiver).
Retrieves the current inclinometer reading using Inclinometer.GetCurrentReading. Returns pitch, roll, and yaw values in degrees corresponding to rotation around the x, y, and z axes.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Get light sensor reading

items.docs: Retrieves the current ambient light sensor reading using LightSensor.GetCurrentReading. Returns illuminance in lux and optionally chromaticity coordinates.
Retrieves the current barometer reading using Barometer.GetCurrentReading. Returns atmospheric pressure in hectopascals (hPa).

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Get orientation sensor reading

items.docs: Retrieves the current orientation sensor reading using OrientationSensor.GetCurrentReading. Returns a rotation matrix and quaternion representing the device's spatial orientation. The orientation sensor fuses data from accelerometer, compass, and gyrometer for smooth results.
Retrieves the current pedometer reading using Pedometer.GetCurrentReadings. Returns step counts categorized by step kind (walking, running, unknown).

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Get proximity sensor reading

items.docs: Retrieves the current proximity sensor reading using ProximitySensor.GetCurrentReading. Returns whether an object is detected and optionally the distance in millimeters.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Get human presence sensor reading

items.docs: Retrieves the current human presence sensor reading using HumanPresenceSensor.GetCurrentReading. Detects whether a user is present, absent, or engaged, with optional head position and orientation data.
